name: Mary Of Bethany
overview: Mary of Bethany is portrayed in Scripture as a devoted follower of Jesus, living in the town of Bethany alongside her sister Martha and brother Lazarus, whom Jesus loved (John 11:1, 5). While Martha actively greeted Jesus upon His arrival, Mary is noted for her quiet, contemplative presence, remaining in the house as Jesus approached (John 11:20). The setting of Bethany serves as a backdrop to Jesus' intimate relationship with this family, highlighting Mary's role in the household that welcomed Him (Luke 10:38; John 12:1). These passages reveal Mary's faith and reverence in the context of Jesus' ministry and miracles.
